_about: Where to stand at each travel point, learned from recordings. 'terminal': a spot within 8 m of the ticket terminal (the server's limit for /purchaseTicket). 'board': a spot within 25 m of the shuttle/transport (the limit for /boardShuttle). 'to_board' / 'to_terminal': recorded walks (world x, z) for places where a straight line won't do (starport interiors). Points not listed here: the bot stands where it arrived and tries.
